title: DefaultRouteInput
description: Body of PUT /default-route. Only action.quality_bias is writable (absent = 50); every other routing-rule field is fixed on the Default route and may be echoed back only with its current value (else 422 immutable_field), so the GET body can be PUT back. Unknown keys are a 422.

project_id.description: Fixed on the Default route: absent, null or the current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
